text:
The output noise is about 12× above my model. At 1 kHz it is flicker-dominated, and NMOS flicker in SKY130 is large. A PMOS input pair cannot fit, because its Vsg (Vth ≈ 1.0 V) does not leave room at Vcm = 0.9 V. So I keep the NMOS pair and grow its gate area about 15–20× (longer L, higher gm/Id, more tail current). The PMOS loads get longer L and lower gm/Id. I also scale the noise model up to match the simulation.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Noise is 1/f-dominated, about 12x the model. Grow input-pair W*L ~15-20x (L1=3um, gm/Id 22, itail 50uA). Use longer, lower-gm/Id PMOS loads. Raise Cc for the higher gm1. Scale flicker coefficients ~150x to match simulation. Power stays near 0.5 mW."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (22, 16, 26),
    "L1":    (3.0, 1.5, 5.0),
    "itail": (50e-6, 20e-6, 100e-6),
    "gmidp": (8, 6, 12),
    "Lp":    (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),
    "i2":    (200e-6, 100e-6, 300e-6),
    "gmidn": (12, 8, 16),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "cc":    (5e-12, 2e-12, 10e-12),
    "rzk":   (1.5, 1.0, 3.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    it, i2, cc = p["itail"], p["i2"], p["cc"]
    i1 = it / 2

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.4, vsb=0.25)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i1, vds=1.0)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i2, vds=0.9)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], it, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], i2, vds=0.9)

    rz = p["rzk"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "out1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "out1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "out1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.R("RZ", "out1", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", cc)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    c1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * cc + c1 * cl + cc * cl))
    fmirror = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd))
    wz = 1.0 / (cc * (rz - 1.0 / m6.gm)) if rz > 1.0 / m6.gm else 1e30
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / fmirror)) * 0.5 \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(2 * PI * gbw / wz))
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    sv2 = 2 * (8.0 / 3.0) * kT / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    wl = max(m1.W * m1.L, 1e-3)
    wlp = max(m3.W * m3.L, 1e-3)
    # flicker coefficients calibrated ~150x up vs earlier guess (sim/pred = 12.6 in amplitude)
    kn, kp = 4.5e-13, 1.5e-13
    sv_f = 2 * (kn / wl) + 2 * (kp / wlp) * (m3.gm / gm1) ** 2
    noise = math.sqrt(sv2 + sv_f)
    power = vdd * (iref + it + i2)
    slew = min(it / cc, i2 / (cc + cl))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "noise_1k": noise, "slew": slew}
```
